en: The image depicts an old sepia-toned photograph bordered by a white frame, typical of early 20th-century postcards. It shows a grand, two-story neoclassical building with ornate window decorations, situated on a tree-lined street. In the background, there is a larger, multi-story building set against a rocky, mountainous landscape. The area appears to be well-maintained, with manicured trees, fencing, and electric poles visible.
